bloodPath.label: Body tissues
bloodPath.note: Organs hand over carbon dioxide and pick up oxygen.

bloodPath.label: Venae cavae
bloodPath.note: Two large veins return the oxygen-poor blood to the heart.

bloodPath.label: Right atrium
bloodPath.note: Collecting chamber behind the tricuspid valve.

bloodPath.label: Right ventricle
bloodPath.note: Pumps at low pressure into the lungs.

bloodPath.label: Lungs
bloodPath.note: Capillaries around the alveoli swap gas in under a second.

bloodPath.label: Left atrium
bloodPath.note: Receives four pulmonary veins of bright red blood.

bloodPath.label: Left ventricle
bloodPath.note: The strong pump feeding the whole body.

bloodPath.label: Aorta and arteries
bloodPath.note: Distributes blood, with the coronaries branching off first.

bloodPath.label: Arterioles and capillaries
bloodPath.note: Exchange happens in vessels one cell thick.

bloodPath.label: Venules and veins
bloodPath.note: Low pressure return, helped by valves and muscle pumps.

oralRoute.label: Gut absorption
oralRoute.note: The substance crosses the intestinal wall into the portal circulation.

oralRoute.label: Portal vein
oralRoute.note: Everything absorbed from the gut is routed to the liver first.

oralRoute.label: Liver first pass
oralRoute.note: The liver metabolises part of the dose before it reaches the rest of the body.

oralRoute.label: Hepatic veins
oralRoute.note: What survives first pass leaves through the hepatic veins.

oralRoute.label: Inferior vena cava
oralRoute.note: Carried upward into the right atrium.

oralRoute.label: Right atrium and ventricle
oralRoute.note: First pass through the heart, still oxygen-poor.

oralRoute.label: Lungs
oralRoute.note: The whole cardiac output passes the lungs, so the substance does too.

oralRoute.label: Left atrium and ventricle
oralRoute.note: Now oxygen-rich and heading for the body.

oralRoute.label: Aorta
oralRoute.note: The coronary arteries branch off here, so the heart muscle sees the substance almost immediately.

oralRoute.label: Coronary arteries
oralRoute.note: First branches off the aortic root: the heart feeds itself before the body.

oralRoute.label: Systemic circulation
oralRoute.note: Distributed to tissues, then metabolised and cleared.

notes: This is a schematic of absorption and distribution, not a pharmacokinetic model.
Real timing depends on the substance, formulation, food and individual physiology.
